FAQs

Where is the Discover travel card accepted?

Discover is accepted at 99% of places that take credit cards nationwide. 3 Use it for travel expenses and purchases like getting a rental car, or booking a hotel stay. And just as easily use it for everyday purchases like groceries, gas, and paying bills.

What is the interest rate on a Discover travel card?

The APR you qualify for depends on your credit history and other factors. You can see if you’re pre-approved for a personalized offer now on this page. Remember: Discover it Miles has no annual fee.

What are the different ways I can redeem miles?

When you think of the best travel credit card for you, you likely want a card that allows you to have flexibility when you travel, and a card with rewards that you can use for everyday purchases. With Discover it Miles, you get all of that. And as soon as you start earning rewards on your card, you can redeem them as a statement credit. Because once you make a purchase, you simply redeem your miles as a statement credit towards that purchase. 1 So book the travel that works for you, and use your miles to credit yourself back. Eligible purchases include car rentals, hotels, rideshares, gas stations, restaurants and more. 1 You can also use miles like cash, without losing any value for your rewards. Turn miles into cash in any amount, any time, 1 by depositing into your bank account; or use miles when you pay with PayPal at select merchants. 4 However you redeem, miles keep the same value. 1 And your miles don’t expire for the life of the account. 1

How many Discover credit card miles does it take to redeem for a flight or other travel purchase?

With the Discover it Miles Credit Card, when you’re ready to redeem your miles, 100 miles = $1 to redeem for cash or travel credit. The great thing about the miles that you earn with the Discover travel card is that they can be used to cover all or part of a travel expense. So the amount of credit card miles that you’ll need to redeem to cover your entire airline ticket will depend on the price of the flight that you booked. This goes for other travel purchases, too, including rideshares or rental car bookings. Remember — you can redeem your miles for a statement credit for all or part of your travel purchase.

How can I earn credit card miles for everyday purchases?

With the Discover it Miles credit card, you’ll earn unlimited 1.5x miles on every purchase you make, every day. That includes credit card travel purchases like hotels as well as daily purchases like groceries, bills, or gas. 

Can I redeem some credit card miles and keep adding to the remaining balance?

Yes. There is no minimum requirement to how many miles you have to redeem at a time. If you don’t use all of your miles when you redeem, you’ll just keep adding more miles to your total with every purchase. Your miles won’t expire for the life of the account. 1

Why choose Discover it Miles as my travel credit card?

You have to decide the best travel card for your needs. Discover it Miles gives the perks of a travel card with the flexibility of an everyday rewards card. You’ll earn 1.5x miles on every purchase, so it’s easy to rack up rewards fast to reach travel goals. You can redeem your miles as a statement credit toward your Discover bill, or for cash in any amount, any time. 1 Card membership includes more benefits, like great service and security benefits.

How does a miles rewards credit card help you earn travel rewards?

With Discover it Miles, you’ll earn 1.5x miles for every dollar you spend on a travel purchase or any other purchase, with no limits on how much you can earn, and no annual fee. Your miles won’t expire for the life of the account. Easily redeem miles as a statement credit for travel purchases or get cash. 1 Other travel credit cards, such as an airline credit card, may offer different rewards points and your card membership may include an annual fee.

Can you use Discover it Miles for travel insurance and global entry purchases?

Discover is accepted at 99% of places that take credit cards nationwide, 3 including travel insurance companies. The U.S. Trusted Traveler Programs accept Discover Credit Cards as a form of payment for programs such as TSA PreCheck and Global Entry. And, the Discover it Miles card is a rewards credit card that gives you points for travel expenses and every other purchase you make with your card. So it can be your travel credit card and your everyday card. And unlike many travel credit cards, Discover it Miles credit card charges no annual fee even after account opening.
